title: Forged Horizons
description: This mod is to add metals for use
body:
Forged Horizon adds a growing foundation of metals, tools, and equipment built for future expansion into deeper progression systems.

At its core, the mod introduces silver as the first fully implemented material, including:

Silver ore and raw silver generation
Smelting and blasting progression
Silver ingots, nuggets, and storage blocks
Full tool set (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe)
Complete armor set

This mod is designed as a framework for future updates, where new materials, systems, and mechanics will expand the world into a larger progression-based experience.

Forged Horizon is currently focused on providing a stable and polished early-game content expansion while laying the groundwork for upcoming features such as advanced materials, worldgen expansion, and progression systems.
